title: Nigeria WebGIS cross-border geographic data policy

geographic_reference.diagnostic_land_mask: Dissolved admin_states_gadm_pg excluding the non-administrative Water body / Lake Chad row
geographic_reference.diagnostic_country_context: reference_africa_countries_pg (Natural Earth) for neighbouring-country and marine diagnostics
geographic_reference.legal_status: Diagnostic references only; none is a legal boundary, territorial-sea delineation or proof of sovereignty
geographic_reference.lake_chad_rule: Do not count Water body / Lake Chad as a Nigerian state or LGA or treat the whole lake as Nigerian land
geographic_reference.marine_rule: Outside the land mask may mean valid marine or coastal context; it does not by itself mean a coordinate error or an EEZ determination

national_aggregation_rules.feature_counts: Use an explicit, named Nigeria analysis mask. Separate wholly inside, intersecting/boundary, foreign-only and marine/unassigned counts; never equate an extraction bounding box with Nigeria.
national_aggregation_rules.point_measurements: Classify by actual point geometry and report boundary, marine and foreign context separately. Do not assign a foreign point to the nearest Nigerian state or LGA.
national_aggregation_rules.area_and_length: For a Nigeria-only measurement, intersect a copy with the named analysis mask and label the result as clipped. Preserve the source geometry and also disclose whole-feature totals where relevant.
national_aggregation_rules.transboundary_systems: Report the whole-system total separately from the Nigeria-only clipped portion. Never add a whole transboundary area or length to a Nigeria total without labelling it.
national_aggregation_rules.rasters: Use both the analysis mask and the source valid-data mask. NoData outside Nigeria or outside source coverage is not zero and must not be interpolated solely to complete a national total.
national_aggregation_rules.regional_reference: Exclude regional/global reference and map-sheet furniture from Nigeria thematic totals unless a separate, explicitly clipped derivative is documented.
national_aggregation_rules.current_application: Catalog metadata states the required interpretation; the generic Area summary is focus-area based and is not an automatic sovereignty or country filter.

nigeria_focused.description: Nigeria is the intended thematic or administrative scope. Boundary/generalisation differences require review, while foreign-only features are not automatically accepted.
nigeria_focused.scope_note: Nigeria-focused; cross-border exceptions require feature-level explanation

nigeria_with_context.description: A Nigeria extraction intentionally includes neighbouring-country, coastal or marine context. Context remains visible and must not become a Nigerian administrative assignment or national total.
nigeria_with_context.scope_note: Nigeria extraction with declared neighbouring-country, coastal or marine context

transboundary_system.description: A natural, cultural or network feature can continue across an international border. Preserve the whole feature and distinguish whole-system from Nigeria-only measurements.
transboundary_system.scope_note: Transboundary feature; preserve whole-system context and clip only derived Nigeria-only measurements

regional_reference.description: A regional, continental, global or boundary-reference layer is not a Nigeria-only thematic total.
regional_reference.scope_note: Regional/global reference; Nigeria containment and national totals are not implied

map_sheet.description: A scanned-sheet derivative or map-sheet furnishing can include neighbouring countries, marginalia, graticules and boundary lines outside the land mask.
map_sheet.scope_note: Map-sheet content can extend beyond Nigeria; preserve sheet context and exclude foreign content from Nigeria-only analysis

raster_window.description: A numeric raster has a source grid/window and valid-data mask. Geographic window and NoData semantics take precedence over a rectangular Nigeria assumption.
raster_window.scope_note: Raster window; use the analysis AOI and source valid-data mask rather than treating all window cells as Nigerian observations

reference_world_countries_pg.scope_note: global reference; Nigeria containment not applicable

reference_africa_countries_pg.scope_note: continental reference; Nigeria containment not applicable
